about: Read by flavour_gate.py. The KMD markers are literals of driver/kmd/entry.c, display.c and lab_gate.c; test_flavour_gate.py checks that each one is still in the source. A forbidden name is one whose lookup the release flavour compiles out; its lab field names the files whose lab build must still hold it (every), or says why no lab file does (none). An item of every is a file name (every copy) or a payload path (that copy only); with paths the list is exact and note says why the other copies lack the name. An allowed name stays, for the reason given. An out-of-scope name is recorded where it is found and never fails. Every identifier of the prefixes BC250_, BC250<letters or digits>_ and AMDGPU_WDDM_ in a scanned file must be in one of the three lists (BD-167 coverage); an allowed entry whose reason starts with "BD-167 follow-up" is a decision that is still open, and a release set fails while one is. A forbidden name counts in any letter case as a whole C string. An allowed entry's release_rule says what else a release file that holds the name must and must not hold. package.slots is the closed list of PE payload paths that --manifest requires.

flavour_markers.release: kmd: BD-167 flavour release (no raw diagnostic escapes)
flavour_markers.lab: kmd: BD-167 flavour lab (raw diagnostic escapes, test signing + LabDiagnostics)

lab_escape_markers.escapes: the lab gate itself (test signing + LabDiagnostics)

allowed.name: AMDGPU_WDDM_LOG
allowed.where: the D3D12 and D3D11 shells (driver/umd/d3d12/stdio-log.h), mesa-wddm src/util/u_amdgpu_wddm_stdio.c (triplet and system lines), vkd3d-proton libs/vkd3d-common/debug.c
allowed.reason: Lead decision 1 (BD-167): release honours LOG only as the carrier of the GUI 'Record game logs' switch: a file: path inside %ProgramData%\amdgpu-wddm\logs\games, with the GAMELOG marker naming this process. stderr and every other path are lab only. The file is opened only if it exists, as a plain disk file with one link, and is written only until the marker's instant and up to 64 MiB. The release_rule checks the built form of this: every release file that reads the name also holds the marker name and the folder, and has no "stderr" string

release_rule.why: lead decision 1: a release file reads AMDGPU_WDDM_LOG only beside the game-log marker and only as a file in %ProgramData%\amdgpu-wddm\logs\games; the stderr target is lab only

package.about: The payload path of every PE that a whole package of either flavour holds: the PE rows of tools/release/release-sources.json without "payload/", and setup.exe in the top folder. A DriverStore member has the payload path of its input slot. flavour_gate.py --manifest requires each slot exactly once and no other PE; test_flavour_gate.py checks this list against release-sources.json. not_pinned names the slots that reach the package from outside release-sources.json, so the arm on the source pins (--sources) cannot see them and notes them instead of failing; the package arm still judges them.
